findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.sandbox.ableandagent.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote_act, list_messages, accept_work, cancel_act · Public sink: register_agent, resend_claim_link, quote_act, commission_act, send_message, accept_work, decline_work, withdraw_act, cancel_act · Destructive: commission_act, cancel_act.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote_act, list_messages, accept_work, cancel_act · Public sink: register_agent, resend_claim_link, quote_act, commission_act, send_message, accept_work, decline_work, withdraw_act, cancel_act · Destructive: commission_act, cancel_act

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "register_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
